coverage.enforcement: Trusted key/profile fix activation, matrix order, heights, widths, quotient slices and cap/FRI schedule. No prover-selectable shape wires.
Claim inverses and per-circuit accumulator chain end at zero (ordinary), or negative constrained message sum (single batch).
Parameter seed, shape, activation, fixed and witness commitments, heights, length-prefixed claims/messages, shard index, accumulators, alpha and zeta.
Canonical bytes, first-valid rejection sampling, constrained state/cursor updates, raw query bits and nonzero-bit grinding. Retry exhaustion fails closed.
Selectors and inverses are constrained; stage2 coordinate polynomials remain separate; normalized accumulator injection, full/partial lookup groups and Horner constraint order match native.
Recombine every slice with extension basis and zeta^(n*i), then enforce composition/vanishing = quotient.
Observe all OOD values in native order; reduce all matrices and points at fixed coset query points with constrained nonzero denominators and per-height alpha powers.
Canonical field encoding; matrix rows grouped by height in stable order; every path direction is derived from transcript query bits; shorter-height rows injected at fixed levels.
Trusted query count; every binary round root, grinding witness, sibling and path; derived beta/index; subgroup fold, beta-squared roll-ins and final constant equality.

Normalization does not cryptographically accept the proof. Expanded values are constrained; fixed dimensions reject missing/extra fields. Duplicate-index consistency is enforced cryptographically by authenticating each path to the same root.

coverage.native: Plonkish gates, lookups, compact hashes and public bindings
coverage.enforcement: Canonical/range and modular arithmetic Boolean relations, fixed constants, pinned ONE in every packed lane, exact byte/word BLAKE3 bindings, copy wiring and public claim bindings.

coverage.circuit: VerifierPlan with fixed message schema and independent expected claim
coverage.enforcement: Original key, active heights and validated closure messages specialize the trusted circuit; all 18 claim words remain public. Native prevalidation is not used in place of circuit checks.

validation.method: 210 mutations per envelope after normalization, covering claims, both challenge/OOD coordinates, all input-query columns and Merkle depths, every FRI round, accumulators, roots, nonces and final polynomial; direct proof mutations also rejected natively
validation.algebra: Every selector, graph node, grouped logUp constraint, composition and quotient compared with native evaluation; groups 1,2,3,8 and partial groups
validation.blake3_raw_matrix_scope: Flip every bit of all 11 wired IO words after witness generation and evaluate Boolean R1CS matrices directly; reject all-zero/unpinned trace

regression_results.clippy_warnings_denied: passed for changed root tests and all Flock targets

terminal_fixed_checks.scope: Implementation and native-oracle/constraint tests; not an independent soundness audit or production security certification.

matrix.binding: Registry digest, ordered A/B identities and dimensions; exact binary sparse matrices, including cancellation of repeated entries; all reported values constrained equal to the evaluations.

layout.binding: Circuit-derived prefix boundaries and fixed addresses; exact Eq and Combo weights. Common factors depend only on fixed boundaries, never private values.

structure.binding: Circuit-derived live masks and masked identity tags, including padded slots and skipped decision variables; constrained plane selectors and values.

permutation.binding: Circuit-derived fixed-table commitment; separate chained-BLAKE3 transcript binds circuit, commitment and the original wiring point; terminal PCS check binds the reported sigma value.
